content: Always provide specific numbers (price, trade-in value, monthly payment) early to address price sensitivity.
Confirm local warranty and service locations to build trust with skeptical customers.
List all included accessories (e.g., spare pen tips) to eliminate last-minute objections.
Use trade-in and installment plans to lower perceived cost and close deals faster.
In a retail setting, leverage in-store actions (scanning, showing screen) to create immediacy.

name: Trade-in + Installment Anchor
condition: When customer objects to high upfront price.
example: If the total is 3,607 zł, offer trade-in and 0% installment to bring monthly payment to 312.70 zł. Show the calculation on a calculator or screen.

name: Local Service Assurance
condition: When customer expresses concern about warranty or after-sales support.
example: Confirm local service center and warranty duration. Provide address or phone number. 'Our warranty is serviced right here in Warsaw, not shipped abroad.'

name: Included Accessories List
condition: When customer asks about additional costs or features.
example: List all items included in the box (e.g., spare pen tips, charger). 'The M-Pencil Pro comes with two extra tips, so you don't need to buy them separately.'

objection: Price is too high compared to Xiaomi lump sum.
rebuttal_template: I understand the upfront cost seems high. But with our 0% installment plan and trade-in, your monthly payment is only {monthly_amount} zł. Plus, you get {feature} that Xiaomi doesn't offer. Let me show you on the screen how the total cost of ownership compares over 2 years.

objection: Warranty service might be in China.
rebuttal_template: No, all Huawei products in Poland come with a 2-year warranty serviced locally at our authorized center in Warsaw. Here's our service center address and phone number. You can also check on our website: consumer.huawei.com/pl/support.
The M-Pencil Pro includes two spare tips in the box at no extra cost. Let me open the box and show you. You can also test the pen on the tablet right now to see the responsiveness.
